The '''BAF-320 Repair Droid''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] that was produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. BAF-320 Repair Droids supported [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in their defense of the factory near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
